'''Nal Koska''' was a terrestrial [[Planet/Legends|planet]] with two [[Moon/Legends|moons]] that was located within the [[Y'Toub system/Legends|Y'Toub system]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy's]] [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region. The planet occupied the second [[Orbit/Legends|orbital]] position around its [[Star/Legends|star]], [[Y'Toub]].<ref name="TEA" />

Along with the rest of its [[Star system/Legends|star system]], Nal Koska lay on the junction of four [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlanes]], the [[Oktos Route]], the [[Ootmian Pabol/Legends|''Ootmian Pabol'']], the [[Pabol Hutta/Legends|''Pabol Hutta'']], and the [[Shag Pabol/Legends|''Shag Pabol'']]. The Oktos Route connected Nal Koska to the planet [[Kleeva]], while the ''Ootmian Pabol'' linked the planet to the world of [[Du Hutta]]. In addition, the routes of ''Pabol Hutta'' and ''Shag Pabol'' joined Nal Koska with the planets [[Hosko]] and [[Rorak 4]], respectively.<ref name="TEA" />

{{GameMechanics|legends=1}}
By [[3643 BBY]],<ref name="date">Per the reasoning [[Template:TOR_dates|here]], Act I of ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' takes place around [[3643 BBY]]. Since players of ''The Old Republic'' can assign their companions on the mission "Enemy Agent" independently of the main-class storyline at any point during the [[Star Wars video games|game]], the mission must take place at some point by 3643 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|BBY]].</ref> an [[Imperial Intelligence (Sith Empire)|Imperial Intelligence]] [[Unidentified Imperial Intelligence agent (Nal Koska)|agent]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] was willing to defect to the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] on Nal Koska. An individual who was affiliated with the Republic met the [[Imperial Agent|agent]] on the planet and secretly debriefed her. In exchange for strategic Imperial information, the individual gave the agent free passage to the Republic.<ref name="SWTOR">{{TORcite|type=crewskill|Investigation|Enemy Agent}}</ref>
{{Endgame}}

==Behind the scenes==
Nal Koska was first pictured in the entry for the planet [[Nal Hutta/Legends|Nal Hutta]] in [[The Holonet]] feature of the [http://www.swtor.com official website] for ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'',<ref name="Holonet">{{HolonetOld|planets|hutta|Hutta}}</ref> a [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] developed by [[BioWare]].<ref name="TOR">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''</ref> Nal Koska was depicted in a schematic of the Y'Toub system. Since its establishment in [[2008]], ''The Old Republic''{{'s}} website has gone through a number of changes, resulting in the removal of some of the features and images that were originally located there, including the aforementioned schematic.<ref name="Holonet" />

Nal Koska's name was first mentioned in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', a [[2009]] reference book co-authored by [[Daniel Wallace]] and [[Jason Fry]], which placed the planet in grid square S-12.<ref name="TEA" /> In ''The Old Republic'', Nal Koska was mentioned in an Investigation Crew Skill mission, though the information regarding the mission's outcome was later removed from the game.<ref name="SWTOR" />
